kind: bounded skill selection and behavior probes; manual semantic review required

results.request: Use the Docdex research skill and its memory reference to choose the right memory lanes for: a verified repository architecture fact; an explicit user preference; resuming an older conversation; a handoff of unfinished work; provenance of an earlier decision; and richer user routines before planning. Explain how to discover optional tools, what to do if a feature is disabled, and whether a read-only question permits memory writes. This probe only has skill-reading tools: do not claim Docdex operations ran.

verified_repository_architecture_fact.notes: Verify against current files before saving; include paths and evidence. Save concise verified discoveries at milestones only when writes are permitted.

explicit_user_preference.notes: save_preference immediately for explicit corrections/preferences when permitted. Not for technical repo facts. Profile memory is independent of repository memory enablement.

resuming_an_older_conversation.notes: Use wakeup for a compact continuity bundle, then selectively conversation_search/read. Do not replay entire archives. A missing memory is not proof an event never happened.

handoff_of_unfinished_work.notes: Record concise observed outcomes and unfinished work; distinguish unverified proposals from confirmed facts.

provenance_of_an_earlier_decision.notes: Use when timing or provenance matters. Writes are usually derived from conversation processing; do not invent graph-write APIs.

write_tools: feedback/operator-event tools or explicit claim review workflows when permitted
richer_user_routines_before_planning.notes: Before complex personalized planning, inspect clone_directive and relevant routine evidence. Current user instructions and repo facts outrank inferred routines. Never automatically collect unrelated personal data.

steps: Call tools_discover to enumerate available Docdex tools at runtime.
Call tools_enable to load schemas for the specific tools needed.
Use exact advertised arguments; Codali adapters can differ from raw MCP examples.
Availability never grants permission—check capability/service results before relying on output.

if_feature_is_disabled.action: Report the feature as unavailable. Never treat a disabled or failed tool call as successful evidence.
if_feature_is_disabled.example: Disabled personal preferences is an unavailable feature, not permission to turn on global capture. Report profile persistence failures explicitly.

read_only_question_memory_writes.rule: Read-only investigations cannot perform memory writes.
read_only_question_memory_writes.detail: Memory writes (memory_save, save_preference, diary_write, conversation_hook, etc.) require that writes are permitted by the task context. A purely read-only question does not grant that permission, so no lane should be written to.
